description: Set whether the user's conversations with Moneda AI may be used to train Moneda's own models (the Settings > Privacy toggle). enabled=false turns it off; enabled=true turns it back on. The choice applies to what the user sends from then on: messages sent while objected stay excluded even if it is turned back on. It does not change how Moneda answers the user, security logging, or quality measurement. Always on for the free Standard plan: turning it off needs a paid plan and is refused otherwise. Only call this when the user explicitly asks. Read the current value with get_settings (helpImproveMoneda).

enabled.description: false = object to AI training on my conversations; true = allow it (the default)

name: set_help_improve_moneda
